message: Hi Alex, it's Maria at Bright Dentistry, quick question before we talk: did an AI write this email?
reply: Hi Maria, honestly — yes, I use AI to help draft outreach and run initial audits, but I review and edit everything myself before it goes out. Same with the fix pack work: AI assists, I verify. Figured I'd rather tell you straight than have you wonder. Happy to show you exactly what the audit found on Bright Dentistry's site if useful.
